method.description: validation-selected blend of a 168-hour seasonal profile and the previous-day value; seasonal profile has a trailing-24-hour residual level correction
method.anomaly_rule_description: absolute centered forecast residual above 6 x 1.4826 x validation MAD
method.evaluation: rolling non-overlapping 24-hour origins; prior observations only

limitations: Results apply only to the selected BDG2 public benchmark cohort, not Sime Darby or Elmina Lakeside Mall.
Whole-building interval kWh does not identify floors, rooms, equipment, operating schedules, causes, tariffs, savings, or HVAC faults.
Anomalies are statistical unusual-consumption patterns and do not establish waste, faults, or causes.
The model uses energy history only and is a small hackathon benchmark, not a production forecasting system.
